title: Night sky suddenly bright in the Brookhaven incident

tellings.quote: It's about 7:00 at night and being November, it was full dark and all of a sudden it was lighter out than it is right now.

plain: Around 7 one November evening in 1992 in Brookhaven, Long Island, New York, the dark night sky suddenly became brighter than it is in daytime. That account comes from an unnamed witness in a clip Michels plays, who says they saw it. The sudden light is the start of what is called the Brookhaven incident.
